title: Interpretable identification of constitutive parameter field for three-dimensional heterogeneous and graded hyperelastic materials from full-field displacements
abstract: arXiv:2611.34310v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The inverse problem of identifying spatially varying material properties of heterogeneous solids using experimentally available displacement fields and boundary reaction forces alone remains challenging. Being able to characterize heterogeneous and graded solids would be advantageous in the design and manufacturing of functionally graded materials and composites. Additionally, an efficient technique for identifying heterogeneous material properties from in vivo measurements would be useful in biomedical contexts to characterize heterogeneous biological tissues. Although several techniques developed over the past two decades have addressed inverse identification for homogeneous materials, including linear elastic, hyperelastic, viscoelastic, and elastoplastic solids, comparatively fewer studies have considered heterogeneous and graded materials. translated_title: 基于全场位移的三维非均质与梯度超弹性材料本构参数场的可解释辨识
translated_abstract: 仅利用实验可获得的位移场和边界反力来辨识非均质固体空间变化材料特性的反问题仍然具有挑战性。能够表征非均质和梯度固体将有助于功能梯度材料和复合材料的设计与制造。此外，一种从体内测量中高效辨识非均质材料特性的技术在生物医学领域中表征非均质生物组织也将十分有用。尽管过去二十年间开发的多种技术已经解决了均质材料（包括线弹性、超弹性、粘弹性和弹塑性固体）的反问题辨识，但相对而言，针对非均质和梯度材料的研究较少。此外，近期几种表征非均质和梯度材料的方法……
tldr: 本文提出了一种可解释的方法，仅利用全场位移和边界反力即可辨识三维非均质与梯度超弹性材料的空间变化本构参数场，为功能梯度材料设计及生物组织表征提供了有效工具。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an interpretable approach to identify the spatially varying constitutive parameter field of three-dimensional heterogeneous and graded hyperelastic materials using only full-field displacements and boundary reaction forces, offering an effective tool for functionally graded material design and biological tissue characterization.
